description: This Java interface defines a builder for handling responses and events related to the 'DeleteFeatures' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including methods for constructing response objects and event notifications.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: A builder interface for creating command responses and event notifications related to deleting features in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for constructing responses to the DeleteFeatures command, including success and error responses.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event instances triggered by the DeleteFeatures command, such as FeaturesDeleted.
